intercessions.prayer: Father, destroy all age long bondages, spells and enchantments in the lives of our new converts and new members, thereby establishing them in this church for life
intercessions.scripture: 23 Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

intercessions.prayer: Father, make Shiloh 2026 a mountain of encounters that will culminate in Far Above testimonies, as the Spirit of God ministers to every participant all through the event
intercessions.scripture: 12 I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now. 13 Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

intercessions.prayer: Father, let there be explosive revelation in all our services this month leading to the invasion of record-breaking multitudes into all our services
intercessions.scripture: 44 And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

intercessions.prayer: Father, let every form of ‘grave’ holding your people hostage be opened at Shiloh 2026
intercessions.scripture: 12 Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

intercessions.prayer: Father, we decree the release of legions of Angels into our harvest field to uproot every satanic installation manipulating people from coming to this church this coming Sunday
intercessions.scripture: 20 Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
